shortlist.label: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD138-positive, CD56-positive, EBV-positive, and gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci on fluorescence in situ hybridization

shortlist.label: Nasal-type NK/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, with specific involvement of the nasal cavity

shortlist.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD138-positive and EBV-positive, although less common in the nasal cavity

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive and involvement of the nasal cavity, although typically more systemic

shortlist.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although CD20-negative, some cases can be negative or weakly positive, and the clinical presentation is plausible

raw.rationale: The presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, CD138-positive and CD56-positive immunophenotype, and EBV-positive status are consistent with nasal-type NK/T-cell lymphoma. The lack of CD20 and PAX5 expression also supports this diagnosis, as these markers are typically negative in NK/T-cell lymphomas.

rejected.label: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While similar to nasal-type NK/T-cell lymphoma, the specific involvement of the nasal cavity and the presence of EBV suggest a more specific diagnosis of nasal-type NK/T-cell lymphoma.

rejected.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
rejected.why: The immunophenotype does not support a diagnosis of plasmablastic lymphoma, as it is typically CD20-negative but often expresses other B-cell markers such as PAX5, and is not typically associated with EBV.

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: The presence of a large polypoid mass and the immunophenotype do not support a diagnosis of lymphomatoid granulomatosis, which is typically characterized by a more diffuse infiltrate and a different immunophenotypic profile.

rejected.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: The lack of CD20 and PAX5 expression, and the presence of CD138 and CD56 positivity, do not support a diagnosis of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, which is typically a B-cell lymphoma with a different immunophenotypic profile.
